jobs.title: Staff GenAI Research Scientist - Agents
jobs.description: As a Staff Research Scientist on the Enterprise Agents team, you will be responsible for keeping up with the latest developments in Agent Context, Information Retrieval, Knowledge Assistants, RAG, Embeddings, and advancing the scientific frontier by creating new techniques that go beyond the state of the art.

jobs.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As our GenAI products continue to evolve, we are seeking multiple GenAI Engineers to drive the next phase of development. You will focus on enhancing LLM quality, expanding GenAI capabilities across Databricks products, and strengthening our platform architecture to enable seamless AI interactions at scale.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As our GenAI products continue to evolve, we are seeking multiple GenAI Engineers to drive the next phase of development. You will focus on enhancing LLM quality, expanding GenAI capabilities across Databricks products, and strengthening our platform architecture to enable seamless AI interactions at scale.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Agent Quality
jobs.description: As a Staff Software Engineer - Agent Quality, you will be a founding member of a new team focused on evaluating and continuously improving Databricks' AI Agents. You will design and scale the infrastructure, tooling, and developer workflows that let researchers and engineers evaluate agents rigorously.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Test-Time Cognition for Agentic AI
jobs.description: Voaige is looking for a strong research engineer to build the systems infrastructure behind their inference-time cognition layer for LLMs and agentic AI. You will implement algorithms for dynamic compute allocation, inference-time search, model orchestration, agent evaluation, and production-scale experimentation. This role is ideal for someone who can turn frontier research ideas into fast, reliable, measurable systems.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Test-Time Cognition for Agentic AI
jobs.description: Voaige is looking for a PhD-level research scientist to help define the scientific foundations of test-time cognition for LLMs and agentic AI systems. You will develop new algorithms for adaptive inference, uncertainty-aware compute allocation, search, verification, and multi-model cognitive orchestration.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: This Senior Platform Engineer role is critical to building and scaling the infrastructure behind OpenHands, including both the SaaS platform and enterprise self-hosted deployments. The team owns the core systems that enable reliable AI-powered developer workflows, and the role offers deep technical ownership across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and platform reliability.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: Build the automation, observability, and tooling that allows Mithril to coordinate GPU compute across multiple cloud providers at scale. You will work directly with the founding team on high-impact infrastructure decisions, from SLO design to capacity orchestration, with clear visibility into the technical and commercial dynamics of the business.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Member of Technical Staff (Consumption)
jobs.description: Work across Mithril's core engineering areas including the developer-facing product, billing, API surface, orchestration engine, and cloud provider integrations. You will own meaningful features end-to-end, shipping against a platform that handles real revenue, spot auctions, reservation pricing, and capacity allocation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Member of Technical Staff (Platform)
jobs.description: Ship features end-to-end across Mithril's orchestration and marketplace engine, supply integrations, and developer-facing surfaces. Build the systems that manage GPU capacity across providers, handling real market dynamics including spot auctions, reservation pricing, and capacity allocation across a heterogeneous supply base.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher, Multimodal LLMs
jobs.description: Build Bland's next-generation multimodal LLM stack, combining speech, text, tools, and real-time reasoning into a single unified system. You'll develop conversational AI models that power AI voice agents serving millions of calls per day, taking ideas from research through production across LLM architecture, real-time speech systems, agent design, and multimodal reasoning.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher, Audio
jobs.description: Spearhead the development of Bland's multimodal LLM infrastructure, integrating streaming audio, tool execution, and dynamic context into a coherent real-time system. This research engineering role sits at the intersection of LLM fine-tuning, real-time speech systems, and agent design, with a focus on building models that define how AI phone agents listen, think, and act.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Work directly with enterprise customers to translate their challenges into production-ready AI voice agents. You'll own end-to-end delivery from discovery through deployment, integrating APIs and data sources to automate real business processes, while embedding within customer organizations to drive adoption and uncover new opportunities for automation at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Architect the distributed systems that enable millions of AI-powered phone conversations at Bland. You'll build and scale Kubernetes-based infrastructure for real-time voice processing and ML inference serving, integrate with enterprise telephony systems (SIP, VoIP, WebRTC), and ensure platform reliability at rapidly growing call volumes.
